project_name: Bust-up close-up anime portrait of this exact character, Gianluca Moretti, 31-year-old Italian GT3 racing maestro. Exact matching handsome Mediterranean features, wavy styled dark brown hair with distinguished silver streaks at temples, neat designer stubble beard, smoldering amber-brown eyes, charming charismatic smile, exact same royal cobalt-blue and liquid chrome racing collar with subtle Italian tricolor piping, pit radio mic clipped to collar. Thick black manga ink outlines, halftone Ben-Day dot shading, dynamic speed lines, cel-shaded anime style, isolated solid background
